expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Constructs default spawn parameters. Copy-constructs spawn parameters. Requests an Actor name; NameMode controls name-collision behavior. Copies initial Actor state from this template instead of the class default object. Sets the spawned Actor's ownership relationship. Sets the Pawn credited as the Actor's instigator. Overrides the destination level; nullptr allows the spawn helper's normal level resolution. Overrides the class collision policy at the requested spawn transform. Controls how a non-empty requested Name is handled when it already exists.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: FActorSpawnParameters Params(); | FActorSpawnParameters Params(const FActorSpawnParameters& Other); | FName Params.Name; | AActor Params.Template; | AActor Params.Owner; | APawn Params.Instigator; | ULevel Params.OverrideLevel; | ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod Params.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride; | ESpawnActorNameMode Params.NameMode;
